findings.subject: not-scaled-values
findings.observed: Max and min reasons use StatusCode Failed with only MaxCapacity or MinCapacity respectively. Exact-current uses StatusCode Successful with CurrentCapacity. All five records have StartTime but no EndTime or StatusMessage; all use Description Attempting to scale due to alarm triggered.

findings.subject: filtering
findings.observed: IncludeNotScaledActivities false or omitted hides all of these records, including AlreadyAtDesiredCapacity/Successful.

findings.subject: deduplication
findings.observed: Same max reason was suppressed across same-policy repeat and another policy, with successful CloudWatch action delivery recorded. Changing max to min and then back to max added a record at each transition. Exact-current repeat was suppressed, including after MaxCapacity changed from 0 to 2. Deregistering and re-registering the same resource/dimension preserved suppression despite a new policy ARN UUID.
findings.scopeInference: Consistent with last-not-scaled-reason ownership by resource/dimension history rather than policy or current registration. Only one ECS resource/dimension was tested; no cross-resource scope claimed.

findings.subject: history-retention
findings.observed: All five ActivityIds retained after explicit deregistration, delayed read, re-registration, ECS service deletion, and cluster deletion. Six-week expiration is documented but not experimentally tested.

findings.subject: query-admission
findings.observed: Dimension without resource returns HTTP400 ValidationException. Nonexistent resource returns HTTP200 empty list. Invalid namespace returns HTTP400 ValidationException. MaxResults 0 and -1 both return HTTP200 empty list, no token. MaxResults 51 accepted HTTP200. Malformed and empty NextToken both return HTTP400 InvalidNextTokenException.

findings.subject: paging
findings.observed: Pure not-scaled history with five entries: MaxResults 1, 2, and 3 return respectively newest 1, 2, and 3, but omit NextToken. Same behavior with resource-only filter. No valid AAS continuation token was available; continuation behavior is inconclusive for mixed or normal activity history.

findings.subject: deleted-service-action
findings.observed: After owned ECS service reached INACTIVE, saved alarm policy trigger produced no new activity during 30-second bounded polling and no new successful CloudWatch Action history. Subsequent delete-scaling-policy and deregister-scalable-target returned ObjectNotFoundException before any cleanup target deregistration succeeded. Absence reads confirmed no target or policies.
findings.scopeInference: ECS deletion appears to remove its AAS registration and policy. Genuine non-suppression Failed activity was not safely reached via this route.

findings.subject: cleanup
findings.observed: Four alarms absent; AAS target and policies absent; ECS service and cluster deletion succeeded with zero tasks/instances; task definition deregistered and deletion accepted, last native state DELETE_IN_PROGRESS. No schedules, EC2 instances, Fargate tasks, VPCs, or IAM mutations created.

paginationOutcome.reason: Native not-scaled-only truncated responses omitted NextToken despite additional history.
